PR: Fix: enforcedCompositonRef change requires pod restart [closed; labels backport release-1.19, backport release-1.20]
### Description of your changes

The `EnforcedCompositionSelector` was caching the `CompositeResourceDefinition` (XRD) object at initialization time, which meant that changes to the `enforcedCompositionRef` field wouldn't be picked up without restarting the Crossplane pod. This change fixes this behavior by fetching the XRD dynamically on each reconcile.

Fixes #6230
